description: Check a Mexican RFC (12 characters for companies, 13 for individuals): structure, encoded date and SAT check digit, plus whether it appears on SAT's public lists under article 69-B of the Código Fiscal de la Federación (taxpayers presumed or confirmed to invoice non-existent operations, also called EFOS) and article 69 (not located, unpaid or cancelled tax debts, tax-crime convictions). Returns the list status with publication dates and a review/fail assessment with reasons. Mexico publishes no RFC registry, so the result never confirms that an RFC is registered or active and never returns pass. Company names are returned only when a SAT list carries them; individuals get list status only, without name or birth date.

rfc.description: Mexican RFC, 12 or 13 characters, e.g. "SAT970701NN3". Case, spaces and dashes are ignored.

name: validate_mexico_rfc
title: Check Mexico RFC (tax ID)
